hypothesis: Training with on-policy ORPO (using the model's own drafts as rejected samples against gold chosen) should better align the adapter to avoid its own failure modes than SFT alone, producing higher-quality questions.
technique: A LoRA adapter fine-tuned with on-policy ORPO (epoch 2), where chosen responses are gold references and rejected responses are the model's own drafted outputs, replacing the SFT baseline adapter.
result: Scored 0.376 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 2 ties / 26 losses vs Sonnet), below the SFT baseline; rubric showed atomicity=5 and spec=4 but coverage and naturalness both stalled at 3, confirming the hypothesis was falsified — discarded.
label: adapter_orpo_op_e2
